items.impact: Normal reading runs could read primary sources but could not safely mark a new or modified paper complete when the generated identity index had to change, because the runtime could not retrieve the entire large index as an editable payload.
attempted_fixes: Verified GitHub read and write operations separately.
Confirmed the format-3 identity index was too large for a complete editable connector payload.
Introduced workflow v7 connector-safe identity deltas so normal paper publication no longer rewrites the full format-3 snapshot.
items.resolution: The format-3 index remains a compacted snapshot. New or changed paper identities are saved as small files under survey-state/identity-deltas/ in the same atomic change as the paper, plan and queue. A checkout-capable maintenance run later validates and compacts them.
items.next_action: Resume the pending reading item using workflow v7; compact identity deltas during the next checkout-capable maintenance run.
